name: Warm Elephant 21
author: gharsh11032000
description: Neon sky-blue toggle switch that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: Clicking it toggles it: background changes from #9fccfa to #0974f1, transform becomes translateX(1.5em) rotate(90deg). On focus, box-shadow becomes 0 0 1px #0974f1.
